sens_en: to throw, to toss, to abandon
origine_fr: Pour s'en souvenir : à gauche, 扌, la main ; à droite, 九, neuf, et 力, la force. Aucun ne se lit pāo : ce sont des formes, la main donne le sens. La main met toute sa force pour lancer loin, puis lâche : jeter, abandonner, 抛弃.
origine_en: As a memory aid: on the left, 扌, the hand; on the right, 九, nine, and 力, strength. None of them is read pāo: they are shapes, and the hand gives the meaning. The hand puts all its strength into a long throw, then lets go: to throw, to abandon, 抛弃.

mots.en: to set aside, to cast off

phrase.pinyin: Tā bǎ qiú pāo gěi le wǒ.
phrase.en: He tossed the ball to me.
